verdict.rationale: Stale-flag detection and code-reference scanning are a fair axis for a feature-flag platform, but the evidence pack never documents either. The only nearby items are a guard against archiving prerequisite flags and a general management API. The first is an adjacent control and the second is a developer building block, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can find stale flags and code references so temporary flags actually get removed from the codebase
